items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: who else was in the Buccaneers... Charlie Temple was a guitar player... That's the way we... Eddie Smith was in the band too

ctx.x: Yeah, cause Baby Bruce is a mechanic of the game. Yeah. Uh, and who else was in the Buccaneers, you say? What did the leader play, you say?

Trumpet, Earl Anderson. Earl Anderson. And, uh, Charlie Temple was a guitar player. The two Knox brothers was, uh, Alto and, uh, and Tenor. That's the way we, Eddie Smith was in the band too at one time. He was a Tenor player. Well, after Eddie left, they went to Eddie Highted, uh, the other Knox boy. Edward Knox and Duncan Knox. Which plays Tenor? Uh, Duncan, uh, Edward played Tenor. Mm-hmm. Dungeons play, uh, Alto and, uh, Baritone.
Would you call that a swing band, or rhythm and blues band, or Dixieland?
